test_case.test_name: One-shot UMC replay-correctable ODECC injection with OOB/in-band CPER correlation
test_case.purpose: Inject exactly one approved type-4 replay-correctable ODECC into the mapped UMC/HBM target and prove OOB/in-band CPER consistently report the intended OAM, UMC, ext0 HBMEccErr and Corrected severity.
required_package: Compatible amdgpuras/firmware/driver/Redfish/cdump versions and field schema
Dedicated isolated SUT, explicit one-shot authorization and tested console/reboot recovery
Authenticated paginated CPER access, secure transfer, immutable storage and event-cardinality policy
test_case.test_command: RAS-INJECTION GATE CLOSED. After signed prerequisites, preserve complete baselines and execute exactly once `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 4 -a 0x800000000`. Capture complete command/health evidence, enumerate all post CPER entries, bind and securely hash/decode the causal attachment, then compare every required field with `amdgpuras -C`. Do not substitute type 2, clear logs, use max-ID/plaintext shortcuts or reinject.
test_case.expected_result: One approved replay command succeeds; the approved new event set is causally bound and reports mapped OAM, UMC, ext0 HBMEccErr and Corrected severity through both OOB and in-band paths, without collateral fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed replay mapping, one exact type-4 injection, complete manifests, verified attachment/decode, all fields and in-band agreement. FAIL on substitution, wrong target, command/event/field mismatch, extra event, gap or instability. Missing prerequisites is NOT READY.
